TRouter

Purpose: OpenAI-compatible AI gateway with routing, billing (PAYG + subscriptions), teams & budgets, audit logs and admin analytics.

Key pages:
- https://t-router.com/ (Landing, features, supported providers/models)
- https://t-router.com/login (Console login)
- https://t-router.com/register (Console register)

Supported providers (configurable):
- Anthropic
- Google Gemini
- OpenAI
- DeepSeek
- Kimi
- MiniMax

Highlighted models (configurable display names; unified model IDs):
- Gemini 3 Pro
- GPT 5.2
- Claude 4.5
- DeepSeek V3.2
- Kimi K2.5
- MiniMax M2.7

Billing rules:
- PAYG: deduct balance with idempotent charging
- Subscription: deduct plan quota first for covered models; overage falls back to PAYG
- Teams: API keys can be attached to an organization; monthly budgets can block new requests when exceeded
